name: s4_diagnose
_purpose: Follow-up diagnostics after the final 3-seed retrain showed the tuned primary (dropout=0.2, K=16, batch=128) underperforming the original untuned primary (45.76% vs 46.70%), despite winning the 12-epoch/single-seed validation search. Each run isolates one hypothesis: (1) batch-size confound, (2) untested lr for primary, (3) extending the K trend past 16, (4) checkpoint-selection criterion, (5) capacity+regularization combined.
